content:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — scheduling a dry-run for the joint HW announcement (H100/H200 + Gaudi + MI300) next Wed. Need partner handoffs, marketplace SKU tags, and SI smoke tests confirmed by EOD Monday.
Maria Gomez: timeline? press slot still 10am PT?
Alex Chen: yes 10am PT. Dry-run will exercise embargo handoff, marketplace publish simulation, and SI integration sanity checks.
Samir Patel: pushing for a 9:15 internal pre-brief to catch any last-minute firmware/driver blockers. Can infra run a mini-staging at 8:30?
Jin Park: lab capacity looks tight that morning (Gaudi bench). I can shift a soak to Tue night to free slots, but need partner images by 6pm Tue.
Elaine Ho: Marketing wants the preview artifacts (pngs + copy) by Tue 11am for the comms queue. Also confirm embargo window: are we keeping the standard -48h partner embargo?
Alex Chen: yes, standard -48h. Partner teams requested a tighter handoff for MI300—they want a +2h grace window for final verification.
Maria Gomez: noted. For marketplace, we need SKU tags: h100,h200,mi300,gaudi-v1. PartnerBot, can you list current tag coverage?
partner-bot: Current marketplace tag inventory: [h100: ok], [h200: pending image], [mi300: ok], [gaudi-v1: pending kernel patch].
Samir Patel: action items: 1) Firmware freeze cutoff Mon 5pm PT. 2) Driver build and marketplace image by Tue 6pm. 3) SI smoke test run Wed 7:30am PT.
Jin Park: for SI smoke tests, please include the kernel log capture:
```
# run smoke
./run_smoke.sh --record-kv --limit 30m
journalctl -u inference-runtime -o short-precise > /tmp/kern.log
```
Samir Patel: perfect. Also add a quick perf sanity: 50 token latency check against h100 and gaudi images.
Elaine Ho: comms note — if MI300 slips, we must hold the public blog and only announce H100/H200+Gaudi. Is that fallback acceptable?
Maria Gomez: yes, but we need a pre-approved alternate title and shortlines. I'll draft two versions and circulate.
Alex Chen: partners to confirm: NVIDIA, Habana (Gaudi), AMD. Maria/Jin/Samir — can you ping PMs and request confirmation by Mon EOD? Use this short template: "Confirm image tag + marketplace readiness + SI smoke window for Wed 10am PT dry-run."
Maria Gomez: sending now. @Samir @Jin please follow up if no ack by Tue 9am. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: will follow. Also coordinating with Eng-Infra for a fallback routing policy in case H100 capacity dips — prefer H200 then gaudi.
partner-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2025-03-19 10:00PT. Reminder set for 2025-03-19 09:15PT internal brief.
Jin Park: added the kernel-patch owner to the thread (DM sent).
Alex Chen: great — thanks everyone. I'll collect confirmations and post a final runbook by Tue noon.
Elaine Ho: runbook checklist suggestion: embargo contact, marketplace tags, image digest, SI test results (pass/fail), perf snapshot, marketing assets ready.
Maria Gomez: copying that into the doc. I'll attach the two headline variants in the morning.
Samir Patel: if anything blocks the marketplace publish, we default to a staggered announcement: partners first, then marketplace 2h later. Documenting that fallback in the runbook.
Alex Chen: perfect. Last call: any other blockers?
Maria Gomez: none from comms.
Jin Park: none from lab after the Tue shuffle.
Samir Patel: none from infra now.
partner-bot: Acknowledged. Thread closed for updates; reply-to-thread for urgent changes. :bell:
